stemMd: Town P recorded twice as many cycling injuries as town Q. A speaker concludes that an individual cycling trip is riskier in P. What missing information is most relevant?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The colour of each town hall

options.label: B
options.textMd: The date each town was founded

options.label: C
options.textMd: The number of letters in the cyclists' names

options.label: E
options.textMd: The number of cycling trips made in each town

explanationMd: Risk per trip requires injuries divided by trip count. More injuries can reflect more cycling rather than a greater chance of injury on each trip. The exposure denominator is essential.

distractorRationale.b: This does not establish present trip-level risk.
distractorRationale.d: This has no bearing on injury risk per trip.
distractorRationale.a: This is unrelated to the denominator.
